plan.summary: ROUND 3c (2026-10-04): FAN2 - the SoM heatsink fan (owner: Puzhi 12 V 0.15 A 2-wire fan on an XH 2.54 plug, red = pin 2 = +12 V, as KFB J24) gets its own always-on regulated channel: U109 LMR54406FDBVR buck from PWR_V12 (11.99 V; 11.62-12.36 V regulated at >= about 12.8 V in, dropout below), enabled by PWR_EFUSE_PG through R146 1 MOhm with R147 4.7 MOhm hold-up, L107 33 uH, J105 JST B2B-XH-A (pin 2 = FAN2_12V). No FPGA, MCU, V3V3 or pin state can stop or slow it in the default build. Monitoring: R148 1.5 Ohm 2 W return shunt (D116 S1M bypass) and U116 TLV1821 synthetic-tach slicer -> FAN2_SENSE (J2.C60 / A9); optional DNP trim (C1109/D114/C1110 pump, D115 blocking diode, R1101-R1104) driven only by a TOGGLING FAN2_TRIM (J2.C57 / F9, 25 kHz-1 MHz).
